messages:
alex: Quick sync — planning dashboards for region/zone latency and to show cross-region failover impact + traffic split. Need Runtime + Infra inputs. Can we align on metric names and cardinality?
priya: +1. Currently we emit request_duration_seconds histogram with labels {region, zone, model, instance_type}. Need to add 'served_from' for failover origin and 'traffic_bucket' for split A/B.
josh: Runtime can add served_from and traffic_bucket. Concern: traffic_bucket could explode cardinality if we use user-specific values; limit to named buckets. Proposal:

```
request_duration_seconds_bucket{region="us-east1", zone="us-east1-b", served_from="us-west1", traffic_bucket="split-blue"}
```

emma: For dashboards we need p50/p90/p99 by region+served_from, and a panel for failover-rate = increase in served_from != region over baseline. Suggest PromQL snippet to compute failover rate:

```
failover_rate = sum(rate(requests_total{served_from!=""}[5m])) by (region) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (region)
```

li: Console UX note: we'll need these as per-route filters and a 'failover impact' tag in rollout view. Also add a small inline legend explaining "served_from" vs request origin. Will mock.
alex: Does infra need any extra telemetry (probe, health check)?
priya: Yes — plan to add a short-lived probe metric `probe_latency_ms` emitted from zone probes every 30s with labels region/zone/target_region. That will help isolate network vs runtime latencies.
josh: Good call. We'll also emit `kv_cache_miss_ratio` by region so dashboard can correlate cold-cache spikes with higher p99.
emma: Dashboard panels I'll draft: heatmap p99 by region-zone (color = p99), timeseries of failover_rate, stacked area showing traffic_bucket distribution, and a diagnostics panel with probe_latency_ms and kv_cache_miss_ratio. Will attach Grafana JSON when ready.
alex: Small implementation constraints: keep extra labels minimal. traffic_bucket should be an enum string (max 20 values). served_from only when different from request_region to avoid label churn.
priya: Ack. infra will enforce label cardinality guard in exporter.
josh: ETA: add labels + probe metric in runtime repo in ~3 days (PR with tests).
priya: ETA: deploy zone probes and exporter changes in ~4 days, but we'll feature-flag probe to avoid noise.
emma: ETA: dashboard draft in 2 days; will include alert recommendations (p99 > 300ms or failover_rate > 0.05 for 10m).
li: UX mock for rollout view to expose failover impact and traffic_bucket filters — ETA 1 week.
alex: Action items recap: josh -> runtime labels + kv/probe metrics; priya -> infra probes + exporter cap; emma -> dashboard panels + alerts; li -> console UX mock. I'll open a tracking ticket and link PRs. Anyone object?
priya: No objections. Also — we should add a small note in runbooks about interpreting failover_rate vs probe_latency.
josh: Agreed, I'll add a short comment in the runtime README.
alex: Thanks all. I'll schedule a 30m follow-up Thu 10:00am PT and post the ticket. :calendar:
